plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/; no login required or attempted). Map: 'Administrative Office Assistant map for 2026-2027'; program page states 'Catalog 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The map prints the degree total as a range, 61.5-63.5 units, Term 1 as 15-16.5 units and Term 3 as 15-15.5 units. Two slots print ranges: the Term 1 '1.A. English Communication (BC)' choice slot (3-4.5 units) and the Term 3 'Major List A' choice slot (1.5-2 units). Per the standing minimum-credit convention they are recorded at 3 and 1.5 respectively, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum (15 / 15 / 15 / 16.5) and the plan total is the printed minimum of 61.5 units. The Major List A slot's dropdown lists BSAD B48WE (Work Experience Education) and BSAD B69 (Machine Transcription); no course is selected on the map, so both are recorded as the slot's options only. Term 2 prints its Document Processing courses in the order Part 3, Part 2, Part 1; they are recorded in the map's printed order. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots. The map prints a 'Prerequisites' flag on BSAD B66B, BSAD B66C, BSAD B67A, BSAD B67B and BSAD B67C but does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded. Semester milestone headings printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map states it represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements, and advises students to make an appointment to create a customized education plan.
